meta.title: Whale Maid
meta.description: A pixel whale maid beside the composer: she pops an exclamation at your messages, thinks with her chin in hand, writes replies with a pencil, pans a telescope during web search, sneaks a snack every 15 seconds, gets happy and then eats when a turn ends, naps with an inflating snot bubble after 2.5 idle minutes, and can be clicked to rest, work, resize or move.
